get.description: Authorized advisory estimate using the same pricing resolution as reserve. Available with commands: false. Never mutates accounting or dispatches a provider call; budget availability is not admission.

post.description: Billing import command. Requires explicit canImportBilling permission from verified server authentication and host connection ownership. A handler mounted with commands: false answers 404 here after authentication. Never dispatches a provider request.
